answer: Every identity stakes a bond equal to a base fee times its epoch age, locked sixteen epochs before partial release. Each close randomizes which twenty percent get audited, and a fake caught forfeits its entire marble-hard stake plus bonds of accounts sharing its deposit address, making clustering catastrophic. Honest agents accrue interest on locked funds, like quartz forming under pressure, so the cost of honesty is only time. An attacker running fifty puppets must lock fifty escalating bonds and pray none land in the audit lantern, expected loss rising quadratically.
